name: Gem Resources Plc
summary: Gem Resources Plc, established in London, United Kingdom, in 2005, functions as a mineral exploration company. Previously operating as URA Holdings Plc, it adopted its current name in September 2024. The firm primarily concentrates on discovering deposits of graphite, coltan, lithium, niobium, tantalum, beryllium, rubidium, caesium, and rare earth elements. Its portfolio includes stakes in two exploration licenses, collectively spanning 1,284 square kilometers, situated in northeastern Zambia. Furthermore, Gem Resources Plc maintains interests in the Gravelotte Emerald Mine project and a separate emerald mine, both located in South Africa. The company also offers specialized consultancy services.
